selection: For each training family select candidate and checkpoint episode by mean validation reward across three training seeds at budget20; ties choose simpler architecture then earlier checkpoint. Freeze all selected checkpoints before test. Retain all candidates and validations.
blind_baseline_training: Fit public-document risk statistics using the same training company roots, no truth/provenance/reward labels; do not fit during test. Preserve a separate online-only blind strategy.
inference_information: Only public reset/step observations, prior training checkpoints and declared unit action cost. No truth, provenance, evaluator report or generator imports in policy modules.

bootstrap.unit: independent test company; average checkpoint replicates within company first

practical_threshold.rule: Both paired95% lower confidence bounds positive, practical mean thresholds met versus strongest generator-blind baseline and untrained. Report oracle comparisons separately. No global superiority claim unless both transfer directions support it.

stopping: One preregistered four-candidate study. Any subsequent change after test requires new roots and a separately retained protocol; no unbounded tuning.
ppo: Not preregistered: first establish gradient correctness and whether these compact candidates improve. Do not label unimplemented PPO as tested.
